entityFieldPolicy: Every canonical field (definitions, aliases/crosswalks, mechanism, scales, indicators, time/persistence, measurement, sources and nulls) is frozen and inspected. Shared generic indicator/narrative fields do not substitute for construct-specific evidence. No repairs.
rdsReview: All nine actual members are Drivers; PSY-132 is the ninth. No Family RDS and no direct RDS effect.
causalGateReview: All fourteen current incident endpoints are Drivers: STANDARD_CAUSAL. Overlap/inverse appraisal risks still apply even without an RDS; no measured-mediator randomization inferred.

layersConsidered.BIO: Sleep and physiological stress references screened: risk preference differs from probability; physiological response does not identify experienced uncertainty.
layersConsidered.PSY: Capability, control, fear, intention and confidence boundaries; no score-as-construct or state-as-trait inference.
layersConsidered.SOC: Support/group-efficacy and coping protocols; group participation correlations not individual efficacy causality.
layersConsidered.CUL: Cross-country/measurement-invariance research screened; nationality not exact cultural moderator.
layersConsidered.ENV: Noise-control experiments and essential-supply/disaster mechanisms; exact task scope retained.
layersConsidered.INS: Rules, resource access and official risk guidance; policy occurrence/design principles not demonstrated psychological effects.
layersConsidered.INF: Risk/fear/efficacy communication and appraisal; message versus perceived construct separate.
layersConsidered.TEC: Interface/control affordance, privacy and bounded computer protocol; only task-specific control effect supported.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Controlled task contingency, coping programs, risk/efficacy messages.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Everyday mastery or repeated failure plausible but trial protocols do not establish generalized routine effects.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Supply disruption and disaster experience considered; exact target evidence absent or source inaccessible.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Aversive-noise task is experimental exposure, not uncontrolled real-world recommendation.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Actual restrictions/resources and policy messages must be distinguished; no independent exact effect found.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Control/override/privacy availability versus actual use and comprehension.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Support and collective efficacy considered without network/psychological belief conflation.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Risk, severity and efficacy message components screened.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Sleep/stress processes screened; no direct mapping from risk preference or modeled uncertainty.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Risk-message studies can change susceptibility, but messages and conditional/unconditional likelihood measures vary; no single reusable operation/conditional-probability Effect retained.
driverLedgers.gaps: Separate likelihood from severity/worry and future behavior; identify exact message identity before source-level efficacy attribution.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Small average versus subgroup distribution, no inference from significant composite to every probability measure; culture/sleep findings mostly associations or preference proxies.

driverLedgers.noFinding: No exact severity-only action retained; vaccination-message synthesis reported no detected severity change, despite susceptibility change.
driverLedgers.gaps: Specify harm dimension and conditional likelihood; do not infer whole multi-domain severity reduction or increase.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: No supported zero, no general fear-action benefit; potential distress/backfire cannot be ruled out by broad average.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Response-efficacy information is not the target appraisal itself. Behavior/intention outcomes alone do not qualify a direct PSY-010 effect.
driverLedgers.gaps: Independent same-response efficacy measure, truthful efficacy content, factorial separation from self-efficacy.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Response/self efficacy content interactions remain mixed; meta-regression is not an exact-edge moderation proof.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Mastery/training/feedback literature is substantial, but candidate funnel retained no generic capability effect: exact task, intervention identity and capability-vs-motivation measure must align.
driverLedgers.gaps: Package components, within-person capability measure and task-transfer limits; never permanent disposition change from short training.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: CET narrower coping facet cannot imply universal self-efficacy; different message-content results do not negate all capability intervention effects.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Guidance, rules, actual resources and interface controls may change perceived feasibility, but complete guidance is not guaranteed to raise it.
driverLedgers.gaps: Ease/capacity versus controllability dimensions, actual resource/opportunity data, and independent direct PBC measure.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Knowledge of obstacles can lower confidence; legal/institutional permission distinct from psychological perception.

driverLedgers.noFinding: One task-bound contingent-termination effect retained. No general effect of automation override, privacy granularity or real supply continuity established.
driverLedgers.gaps: Task-control versus control of specific stressor; no persistent life-agency, safety or trust effects.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: No broad benefit or recommendation; negative feelings and later performance not conflated; same paper has downstream null/contrary findings.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Coping Effectiveness Training has evidence for a coping-scale change, but package/component definition and scale-facet-to-specified-stressor mapping need research; no broad formal effect retained.
driverLedgers.gaps: Manual-level identity and comparator normalization; clinical pre-HAART context; independent coping and expected-futility measurements.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Group support and coping components cannot receive inferred package effects; maintenance symptoms and optimism are separate outcomes.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Research-needed EA-004 retains proxy evidence only: feelings of helplessness do not establish expected ineffectiveness of actions.
driverLedgers.gaps: Expected action-outcome futility item, timing and persistence; prevent reversed-control double count.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Study 1 nonsignificance and Study 2 feeling effect both explicit; no diagnosed helplessness/depression or causal mediator.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Probabilistic shock-learning study uses modeled uncertainty; no sufficiently aligned direct subjective-uncertainty effect retained.
driverLedgers.gaps: Observed lack-of-confidence measure versus entropy/model inference, state versus trait, disclosure versus uncertainty.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: No model inference labelled empirical observation; information search/anxiety mediation uncreated; unknown not zero.

propertyPolicy: All eleven properties considered. Exact LEVEL effect only for task-contingency candidate. Other properties remain uninvestigated/insufficient rather than zero; no direct STRUCTURE effect on scalar appraisals, RDS or ontology. Reach, subgroups, synergy/antagonism and unintended consequences assessed qualitatively in each ledger; no inferred interaction or ranked benefit.
relationshipPropertyReview: All fourteen reviewed exact causal IDs screened. Fear/efficacy factorial behavioral results do not establish moderation of the exact severity→fear or response-efficacy→intention edge. No relationship-targeted effect retained; no strength/direction/functional-shape/enablement/structure effect asserted. Other dynamic properties uninvestigated, not absent.

skepticalReview.method: Separate second pass after initial source extraction/candidate generation by same automated researcher; not an independent human endorsement.
checks: Read original rating wording: retain control OVER TASK, not stressor-specific control or generalized agency.
Compared Study 1 and Study 2 instead of citing the abstract as uniform success; preserve unsuccessful downstream contrasts and differing designs.
Found Discussion describes exhaustion strongly while Results Study 2 reports no detected group difference. Use result-level record; no exhaustion effect created.
Kept helplessness candidate RESEARCH_NEEDED + UNKNOWN because single emotional feeling item does not establish expected future ineffectiveness.
Retained one primary contingency contribution; helplessness proxy description is DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY to prevent reversed-appraisal/double-count routing.
Rejected causal mediation from CET regression and de Berker fitted uncertainty model; no numerical simulation or pathway.
Compared broad fear syntheses with strict six-study factorial review and vaccination nulls; source overlap, successful-manipulation selection and behavioral-versus-appraisal endpoints explicit.
Reused SRC112 and existing canonical framework IDs; SRC122/SRC-496 are one publication. SRC124 identifier conflict left untouched.

Reviewed actions against 23 production native/legacy identities and two prior Layer identities: task-contingency operation differs from babble exposure, sleep loss, semantic rewrite and information repetition.
All direct targets Drivers; no new governance, activation, source registration, existing-edge revisions or prior pilot changes.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Coping package/source access and measurement alignment limit candidate yield. Final Layer review must reconcile PSY-011/006/012/014 and PSY-132/116 boundaries; no uncertainty-trait merger. Task-control effect narrow and no practitioner permission.
